## 🔍 Key Insights at a Glance

### 📈 Dataset Overview
- **20,108 records** analyzed
- **14 years** of data (Q2 2011 - Q2 2025)
- **91.5% data completeness**
- **5 major categories**: Industry, Age, Sex, Region, Territorial Authority

### 🏆 Top Findings

1. **👥 Gender Milestone**: Female employment (1,134,933) now exceeds male (1,124,807)

2. **📈 Fastest Growing Sector**: Utilities sector up 65.5% (Electricity, Gas, Water, Waste)

3. **🏭 Largest Employer**: Manufacturing averages 218,037 jobs

4. **🗺️ Regional Leader**: Auckland dominates with 682,063 average jobs

5. **👴 Aging Workforce**: 65+ employment surged 108.5%

6. **📉 Youth Challenge**: 15-19 age group showing concerning trends

7. **📅 Seasonal Pattern**: Q1 (March) peak, Q3 (September) trough

8. **🎯 Prime Age**: 30-34 age group has highest employment (278,578)
